title: Kenyan Indigenous Games
status: draft: written 18 Nov 2026 offline for Grade 7 Creative Arts and Sports; not yet checked by a CBC Creative Arts and Sports teacher; not loaded by the live tutor
notes: Use ropes on grass; songs from local communities.

skills.key_step: The child names indigenous rope games (skipping, double rope, tug of war) and says they build fitness, coordination, rhythm and teamwork.

floor.question: How many strands in a simple plait?

board.do: Skipping to a song builds what?

misconceptions.repair: Ask what each game is played with.
Skip for one minute and feel the heartbeat.

misconceptions.ask: In tug of war, what gives the most pull?
misconceptions.repair: Pull with arms only, then lean back with the legs; compare.

checks.question: Name an indigenous rope game.
checks.answer: any of: skipping, tug of war, double rope
